title: After the import: data and cutover
description: Imported databases and volumes start empty. Copy the data in, check each domain is safe to switch, then change DNS. The source keeps serving until you do.

data.title: Copy database data
data.description: Streams a dump from the source database into the managed one and compares row counts. Repeating it replaces the target's contents, so a failed copy is safe to retry.
data.empty: No managed databases yet. Import from a platform first.
data.loadError: Could not load database copy status.
data.passwordHelp: Held in memory for the copy and never stored.

volumes.title: Copy volumes
volumes.description: Volume contents are not moved by the control plane, because that needs root on the source host. This prints the commands to run on this node.
volumes.none: No imported app has a persistent volume or bind mount.

cutover.title: Cutover check
cutover.description: For each imported domain: is the app healthy here, how long clients cache the old address, and where DNS points now. Nothing is switched for you.
cutover.noDomains: No imported app has a domain to check.

hub.title: Migrate a database server
hub.description: Move every database of a source server in one guided run. The source is only ever read: nothing is written to it or removed from it, and you verify every database before you switch anything.
hub.forgetHelp: Removes the plan and the password held in memory. Databases already created here are kept.

safeToSkip.title: What is safe to skip
safeToSkip.never: Never skip: the per-table count check after each copy. It is what proves the data arrived.
safeToSkip.volumes: Volumes: safe to skip if none of your apps keep files on a volume.
safeToSkip.cutover: Cutover check: safe to skip if you switch apps by hand and check them yourself.
safeToSkip.warnings: Warnings can be continued past once you have read them. Blocks cannot.

connect.title: Connect to the source server
connect.description: Enter the server's address and a user that can read every database you want to move. The password is held in memory for this session only. It is never stored or logged.
connect.portHelp: Default for the engine when empty.
connect.error: Could not read the source server
connect.readOnly: Only read-only statements and dump tools run against the source.
connect.advanced: Copy a single imported database instead
connect.localHelp: Reads the container over its own Docker network. A host address on the same machine is not reachable from the helper because Docker isolates networks.

inventory.title: Databases on the server
inventory.summary: {{count}} databases, {{size}} in total. Server version {{version}}, {{free}} free on the target node.
inventory.empty: The server has no databases this user can read. Check the user's permissions and try again.
inventory.targetLabel: Name of the new database for {{name}}
inventory.noneSelected: Select at least one database to continue.

preflight.title: Preflight
preflight.description: Nothing has been written yet. These checks run before any database is created.
preflight.required: About {{required}} needed with a safety margin, {{free}} free. Estimated time {{time}}.
preflight.passwordHelp: The password is no longer held in memory. Enter it again, it is used for this run only.
preflight.fixBlocked: Fix or deselect the blocked databases to continue.
preflight.reach: The helper reaches the source over the {{network}} network.

copy.title: Copy
copy.description: Databases copy side by side. One failing never stops the others, and repeating a copy is safe.
copy.empty: No copy has been started yet. Start it from the preflight step.

verify.title: Verify
verify.description: Every table's row count on the source was compared with the copy. Only exact matches are marked verified.
verify.receiptHelp: A record that each database is verified and the source was untouched. It contains no secrets.
verify.noneVerified: No database is verified yet. Fix the failures above and retry.

cutover.title: Switch your apps
cutover.description: Point each app at its new database, then run the cutover check. Nothing is switched for you.
cutover.reference: In an app's connections, reference it as {{ref}} and the platform fills in the values.
cutover.revealNote: Revealing is recorded in the audit log.
cutover.loadError: Could not load the connection details

hub.loadError: Could not load the migration plan.

appImport.title: Migration wizard
appImport.description: Plan, stage, verify and switch each application one at a time, from Coolify, Dokploy, CapRover or an old server. Your old instance is only ever read, nothing on it is stopped, edited or deleted.
appImport.loadError: Could not load the import session.
appImport.forgetHelp: Forgets the plan and progress. Apps already staged here are kept, use Roll back first to remove them.

safe.title: What this does and does not do
safe.readOnly: Only read requests are sent to the old platform. The credential is kept in memory for this session and never stored.
safe.staged: Staged apps are created stopped and not routed, with environment variables and secrets imported encrypted.
safe.volumes: Volume data is never copied for you. You get the exact command per volume and confirm it yourself.
safe.dns: DNS is never changed for you. You switch each domain when you are satisfied, and can switch back at any time.

connect.title: Connect to {{name}}
connect.description: Use a read-only API token. Add the read:sensitive ability if you want secret values imported, otherwise they come back empty and are flagged.
connect.tokenHelp: Held in memory for this session only, sent in the request body, never stored or logged.
connect.loopback: The source is on this machine (loopback)
connect.private: The source is on a private network
connect.networkHelp: The control plane also needs the matching APP_IMPORT_ALLOW_LOOPBACK or APP_IMPORT_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORKS setting before these are honored.
connect.readOnly: Reading the inventory creates nothing here.
connect.dockerTitle: Claim containers from a Docker host
connect.snapshotHelp: Contains environment variables, including secrets. It is held in memory for this session only, sent in the request body, never stored or logged.
connect.snapshotFile: Or load it from a file

fileDescription.docker: No API token needed. Paste the output of the command below, run on the old server. It reads container settings and environment variables, and changes nothing there.
fileDescription.compose: Paste a docker-compose file. Each service with an image becomes an app, and database images become managed databases. Nothing is contacted.
fileDescription.dokku: Paste the environment of one Dokku app. Only its variables are read, so set the image, port and domains after planning. Nothing is contacted.

connect.testOk: Connected to {{name}}. Found {{apps}} app(s), {{databases}} database(s), {{volumes}} volume(s), {{domains}} domain(s) and {{crons}} cron job(s). {{unsupported}} cannot be imported.

testFailure.credentials: The source rejected the credential. Check the token or password and its permissions.
testFailure.blocked: This address is not allowed. Use the private network options below if the source is on your own network.
testFailure.unreachable: The source did not answer. Check the URL, the port and whether this server can reach it.

inventory.title: Applications found
inventory.description: Pick what to move. Each app shows what it maps to here and exactly what needs your attention.
inventory.empty: No applications were found on the source.
inventory.pickOne: Select at least one app to continue.
inventory.stale: The token is not held any more, so these verdicts are as of the last read. Enter it again to refresh them.
inventory.sizeUnknown: size not reported by the source

preflight.title: Preflight and mapping
preflight.description: Nothing is written yet. Review name and domain conflicts, map old database hostnames to their new place and read the exact changes.
preflight.needsToken: The token is not held any more, enter it again to evaluate environment values.
preflight.mappingHelp: Environment values that mention an old internal hostname are rewritten to the new one when the app is staged. Nothing is rewritten unless it is listed here.
preflight.suggested: Suggested from databases you already moved
preflight.diffHelp: Passwords inside connection strings are masked. Only the hostname changes, so update the user and password if the new database uses different credentials.

run.stageDescription: Creates each selected app here, stopped and not routed. Running it again resumes where a failure stopped and never duplicates an app.
run.verifyDescription: Starts each app, builds or pulls it, waits for its own health check and stops it again until cutover. One failing app never blocks the others.
run.needsToken: The token is not held any more. Go back to Preflight and enter it again to stage.
run.rollbackConfirm: Remove every app this import created?
run.stageNote: Rolling back only removes apps this import created. Volumes are kept on disk.
run.verifyNote: Verifying starts the app briefly. If it runs background jobs they work against the database it is configured with.
run.interrupted: Interrupted by a restart. Verify it again.
run.failedHelp: A failed item never blocks the others. Retry it alone, or fix the reason and run the step again.

volumes.title: Persistent volumes
volumes.description: Copy each volume with the command below, then tick it. Run it once while the source is live and again right before the switch.
volumes.none: None of the selected apps has a persistent volume.

cutover.title: Cutover
cutover.description: Per app: lower the TTL, enable routing here, change the DNS record, then run the post-switch check.
cutover.keepSource: Keep the source running until you are satisfied.
cutover.keepSourceBody: Nothing here stops or changes anything on the old instance. To go back, point the DNS record at the source again.
cutover.none: No verified app with a domain yet.
cutover.receiptNote: A JSON record of what was imported and what remains manual. It holds no secrets.

guide.title: Cutover of {{app}}
guide.safety: Nothing on the source platform is touched. A switch can be rolled back, and a failed verification rolls it back by itself.
guide.manualRecord: Set {{type}} {{domain}} to {{value}}, then press the button
guide.liveHint: Traffic is live here and verified through the public name. Keep the source running for a full traffic cycle.
guide.noRuns: No run yet. A dry run starts the app, probes it through this node's ingress and stops it again without changing a record.

images.title: Move images built on the source host
images.description: These apps run an image that was built on the old server and exists in no registry. The control plane runs docker save on the source over SSH, loads the stream into this node and checks each image ID against the snapshot. Nothing else runs on the source.
images.none: No selected app uses an image built on the source host. Continue to verify.
images.unsupported: This control plane has no node runtime to load images into.
images.loadError: Could not load the image list.
images.sshHelp: user@host or user@host:port. The login must be able to run docker. The host key is trusted on first use and pinned.
images.keyHeld: A key is held for this session, leave empty to reuse it
images.keyHelp: Held in memory for this session only, never stored or logged.
images.agent: Use the control plane's own SSH agent instead of a key
images.pending: {{count}} image(s) not on this node yet
images.noSourceId: The snapshot has no image ID, so the load cannot be verified.
images.viaTunnel: Images are streamed through the same SSH connection, read only. Nothing is run on the old server, and no extra login is needed.

ssh.description: Import from an old Coolify, Dokploy, CapRover or Dokku server with only an SSH login. No platform token and no agent. SSH is used only to reach the Docker socket, and only read requests are sent: nothing is ever run on the old server.
ssh.keyFile: Or load the private key from a file
ssh.keyHelp: Held in memory for this session only, sent in the request body, never stored or logged. Whoever holds this key can act as that user on the old server, so use a key you can remove afterwards.
ssh.advanced: Password, Docker socket path and network options
ssh.socket: Docker socket path on the old server
ssh.readOnlyNote: Read only: lists containers, volumes and images.
ssh.storedConfig: Environment variables and settings come from the running containers. The old platform's own stored config (Coolify's database, CapRover's data folder, Dokku's app folder) is not read.

hostKey.title: Confirm the server identity
hostKey.help: Read the fingerprint the server presents, then confirm it is the same one the old server reports. A wrong or changed fingerprint stops the connection.
hostKey.confirm: This fingerprint matches my old server
hostKey.compare: Compare with the fingerprint on the old server
hostKey.insecureBody: Anyone between this server and the old one could read what is sent, including the key. Confirm the fingerprint instead. This session is marked as unverified everywhere.

ok.title: Connected
ok.reads: Read only: lists containers, volumes and images.

auth_failed.title: The login was refused
auth_failed.body: Check the private key, its passphrase and the user name, then re-check.

host_key_mismatch.title: The host key does not match
host_key_mismatch.body: The server presented a different host key than the one you confirmed. If you expected the change, trust the new fingerprint and confirm it again.

host_key_required.title: Confirm the host key first
host_key_required.body: Read the server fingerprint and confirm it before connecting.

socket_permission.title: The user cannot use the Docker socket
socket_permission.body: Add the SSH user to the docker group on the old server, log in again, then re-check.

socket_path.title: No Docker socket at that path
socket_path.body: Pick the right socket path, or enter it under the advanced options.

socket_forbidden.title: The server blocks socket forwarding
socket_forbidden.body: The old server's sshd refuses forwarding to a Unix socket for this login. Allow stream local forwarding for this user, then re-check.

unreachable.title: The server could not be reached
unreachable.body: Check the address and port, and that this server can reach it, then re-check.

blocked_address.title: That address is not allowed
blocked_address.body: Private network addresses are blocked unless the control plane operator allows them. Cloud metadata addresses are never allowed.

other.title: The connection failed
other.body: See the message below, then re-check.

volumes.title: Copy over SSH
volumes.description: Volumes of running containers are streamed through the SSH connection, read only on the old server, up to {{size}} each. Stopped containers and bind mounts need the commands below.
volumes.reconnect: The SSH login is held in memory only. Reconnect the source to copy volumes.
volumes.fallback: Run the copy again right before the DNS switch to catch the last changes.

exit.title: Exit report
exit.help: What each resource becomes, what still needs you, the DNS switch order and the cutover checklist. Read only.
exit.ready: Every resource is imported and none needs action. Run the safe-to-delete check before you remove anything.

probe.help: The response check reaches this server directly with the domain name, so it works before DNS has moved.

retire.title: Safe to delete the old instance?
retire.description: This turns green only when every check below passes with evidence from this migration. Until then keep the old instance running: it is your fallback.
retire.safeBody: Stop the old instance first and keep it stopped for a few days. Delete it only after that, and keep its backups.
retire.notSafeBody: {{count}} gate(s) are still open. Nothing has been changed on the old instance.

gate.leftovers: Resources the importer could not move

platformImport.retryHint: Run the import again to retry what failed, finished items are skipped.
platformImport.nothingFound: Nothing was found on the source. Check the URL and that the credential can see your projects.
platformImport.connectIntro: Reads apps, databases and settings from the other platform without changing it. The credential is sent to this control plane once per step and is never stored.
platformImport.herokuUrlPlaceholder: Leave empty for the public Heroku API
platformImport.skipTaken: Skip resources whose name is already taken (default renames them)
platformImport.privateLabel: Source is on a private network
platformImport.private: Source is on a private network (needs the control plane opt-in)

importPlan.appearsShortly: It will appear in the app list shortly.
importPlan.nameInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
importPlan.portInvalid: Enter the port the app listens on.
importPlan.domainSuggestion: Domain suggestion: {{domain}}. Add real domains from the app's Domains tab after it is created.
importPlan.nothing: Nothing to deploy was found in this input.

takeover.title: Take over this server's ports
takeover.description: Move ports 80 and 443 from your old platform's proxy to this server's own ingress, with a recorded way back. Do this last, after every app is staged, verified and its data copied.
takeover.rootOnly: Only the root account can take over ports. You can read the preflight, but the Run button stays off.
takeover.acceptUnmanaged: I accept that the domains listed above go offline when the old proxy stops.
takeover.alreadyDone: This server already listens on ports 80 and 443. Nothing is left to do.

hint.applying: The control plane is restarting. This page reconnects by itself.
hint.verifying: Checking every domain. If this does not succeed within {{seconds}} seconds it rolls back by itself.
hint.done: This server now serves ports 80 and 443. The old proxy container is stopped, not removed. Roll back any time.
hint.rolling_back: Restoring the previous addresses and starting the old proxy again.
hint.rolled_back: The previous addresses are back and the old proxy is running again.
hint.failed: Something did not finish. Read the message above, then fix it and re-check.

run.note: A failed verification rolls back by itself after {{seconds}} seconds.
run.dialogDescription: Visitors see a short pause while the proxy stops and this server starts answering.
run.consequenceStop: The old proxy container is stopped, not removed.
run.consequenceRestart: The control plane restarts once to listen on the new ports.
run.consequenceRollback: If any domain fails verification the takeover rolls back by itself.

rollback.title: Roll back the takeover?
rollback.description: The previous listen addresses and TLS settings come back after a restart, and the old proxy starts again.
